description: This is a unit test class for the Timesheet entity within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It tests the creation and properties of the Timesheet entity and sets up test data for the entity tests.

classes.name: TimesheetTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Timesheet entity in OrangeHRM's Time Plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating existing Timesheet data and loading fixture data into the database, then clearing the entity manager.

methods.name: testTimesheetEntity
methods.description: Tests the creation and attribute accessors of the Timesheet entity, asserting that the entity's properties are set and returned correctly.
